patches.value: N001 gives the explicit generator and divided-power actions on e. Complex linearity gives the same coefficients on b e_i, hence on a_i via iota and on beta_i after applying bar. Consequently x_K beta_0=0, x_K beta_i=(lambda-i+1)beta_(i-1) for 1<=i<=lambda, y_K beta_i=(i+1)beta_(i+1) for 0<=i<lambda, y_K beta_lambda=0, and h_K beta_i=(lambda-2i)beta_i for i in I. N002 gives preservation of iota(M_R) by E_ij. Define T_ij by the induced lattice action after pulling back through iota and extending scalars using Phi; then T_ij beta_k=beta_i if k=j and 0 otherwise. Transporting the equality E_ij=binom(lambda,j)^(-1)X_(lambda-i)Y_lambda X_lambda Y_(lambda-j) from N002 gives T_ij=bar(binom(lambda,j))^(-1)X_(lambda-i)^K Y_lambda^K X_lambda^K Y_(lambda-j)^K. This scalar is defined and nonzero, because N002 states that binom(lambda,j) is a unit of R and a unital homomorphism to a field maps units to units.

For all i,j,k in I, T_ij beta_k equals beta_i when k=j and zero otherwise. Also T_ij=bar(binom(lambda,j))^(-1)X_(lambda-i)^K Y_lambda^K X_lambda^K Y_(lambda-j)^K, where the displayed binomial coefficient has nonzero image in K. The generator matrices are: x_K beta_0=0, x_K beta_i=(lambda-i+1)beta_(i-1) for 1<=i<=lambda, y_K beta_i=(i+1)beta_(i+1) for 0<=i<lambda, y_K beta_lambda=0, and h_K beta_i=(lambda-2i)beta_i for i in I.
